games.description: Sark and APL hunt goats and keys, contend with AI teammates, and work up to a successful monster hunt before switching to the chupacabra side.
games.title: Chupacabras: Night Hunt

games.description: The twelve stories of the alien-themed anthology, played solo across seven stream dates. Sark returns to unfinished stories, follows the birthday-party hub, and finishes the last daycare game after a long run of puzzles, shooters, and unusual experiments.
games.title: Dread X Collection 5

games.description: Sark plays the seven horror shooters and investigates the abandoned arctic research base. The solo run begins with ghost photography, continues through diseased animals and bizarre worlds, and ends with a demon-hunting priest and the base’s finale.
games.title: Dread X Collection: The Hunt

games.description: A complete co-op forest hunt with APL Fisher. The pair find swords and supplies, work through the feeding system and defeat the wolf mother. Sark is disconnected at the ending, then watches APL’s clip of the finish.
